extra.reason: Implemented Beads detail projection and per-surface conversation intent summaries; cargo test, release build, CLI smoke, and PTY TUI smoke passed.
Implemented window-scoped registry/backfill, histories validation/migration, multi-repo Beads ordering, bottom info IDs, and validated via tests/build/live cmux window.

Implemented Beads-only live refresh every 5s with stale-generation protection, avoided full/Beads refresh overlap, sorted same-bucket issues by updated_at, isolated tests from real HOME writes, and validated with tests/release build/review.

Aligned mc to the agents blueprint. validate_histories_dir now just checks dir+readable (trusts the blueprint symlink); setup.rs no longer creates ~/data/Sessions or repoints ~/agents/histories (warns if missing); removed paths::session_logs_dir; fixed obsagents_root()/summarize::output_dir() fallbacks from nonexistent ~/agents/Obsidian to ~/agents/obsAgents. Updated 4 smoke tests (2 setup, 1 inverted migrate->preserve, 1 inverted backfill fail->accept). Verified: release backfill-window succeeds against the real vault-backed ~/agents/histories (5 workspaces/17 surfaces); setup leaves the blueprint symlink untouched. 224 bin + 11 smoke tests pass single-threaded (1 pre-existing parallel-race test unrelated).
events.rs: reap orphans (pkill -f) before spawn + kill_on_drop(true); main.rs respawn loop w/ capped backoff. Cleared 9 live orphans. Build clean.
agent_state(): removed 60s hook_status freshness gate; last hook verdict authoritative until next event. Build clean, 230 tests pass.

Added SurfaceKind::Remote (foreground mosh/ssh ⇒ Remote, via from_comm/is_remote_comm). Workspace::is_remote() = any surface Remote. Gated typesafe classifier to remote-only in spawn_load_screen_preview + spawn_refresh_all_screens (local agents covered by hooks). Removed dead file-based load_hook_status + status_dir; hook_status now carried across refreshes via old_hook_statuses (was being wiped every tick by the empty status dir). Build clean; tests pass (cli_prompts failures are pre-existing parallel-race, pass single-threaded).

Hooks-first transition complete: local agents → durable hook_status (no staleness), remote agents → typesafe (gated to remote-only), self-healing subscriber + orphan reaping. Restart mc to run the new release binary.

Shipped mux-state reader for ~/data/mux/sessions JSON, wired WorkspaceState mux_status polling via cmux session_id->workspace_id mapping, removed hook-event/session-frontmatter status derivation, documented retained mc bind/session-history hook as non-overlapping, and added fixture tests for claude/grok-style mux state because no current live mux-spawned claude/grok session docs were running (only stale 2026-06-04 docs present). Verified: cargo build warnings 2 <= baseline 10; cargo test -- --test-threads=1 green; cargo build --release green; release CLI --help/resolve/setup green; global mc --help green; live mc TUI launched and exited with q.
Implemented in src/cmux/events.rs: EVENTS_ARGS shared slice, reap_orphan_subscribers() via pkill -f exact argv before spawn, kill_on_drop(true) on the child. Release build passes.

Info layer now renders on its own dedicated full-width line (footer::render_info_line) directly above the footer; main.rs allocates 3 vertical rows (main / info / footer). render_footer and render_command_bar no longer embed or share a row with the info IDs. Release build passes.

Misfiled — mission-control emits no OS notifications (audit confirmed: no osascript/terminal-notifier/notification call in src/). The 'command finished' notifications are fired by arcmux's hook->notify path (internal/manager/cmuxcli/notify.go). Re-homed to arcmux-wdk.
